text:
Just a warning to veterans of back issues!
I wrote a review about “Farmcare” one week after treatment.
I waited a few days to write a review because I wanted to give a few days for treatment to work.
The response to my review was that they only treat muscle conditions…but I was clear that my problem is a back/ bone issue.
I’m home now and my back is much worse!!
If you have an ongoing back problem go to a professional.
As I found out while being treated…the lady treating me… using a variety of electronic and ultrasound devices had no qualifications in Osteopathy or chiropractic treatment.
I’m sure her treatment suits some people but don’t go there if you have major back issues.
Also $90 Aud is a tad expensive…my professional osteopath in Australia charges the same.
